overview: Swanpool is a small beach on the edge of Falmouth, between Gyllyngvase and Maenporth, with a twist: right behind the shingle bar at the top of the beach is a saline lagoon, Swanpool itself, fed by the sea seeping through the bar and by a stream.
With a car park, café and toilets close by, it’s an easy beach to fit into a Falmouth day, and the coast path crosses the bar so you can walk on to Gyllyngvase or Maenporth.

expect.title: Beach and lagoon
expect.text: A small sandy beach with a nature-rich lagoon right behind it.

expect.title: Coast path
expect.text: Walk the coast path along the bar and on to Falmouth’s other beaches.

goodToKnow.label: Where it is
goodToKnow.text: Just outside Falmouth, between Gyllyngvase and Maenporth.

week.slot: Two hours to half a day
week.text: An easy, sheltered beach for a Falmouth day, facing south-east out of the westerly winds. Walk along the coast path to Gyllyngvase for a café stop.

pairWith.why: a calm cove further along the coast

tips: Look out for birds on the lagoon behind the beach.
